description:
Pixel Launcher (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.google.android.apps.nexuslauncher)
Used to be called Nexus Launcher(back when Google's phones were called Nexus, not Pixel).
A launcher is basically your homescreen.
DON'T REMOVE IF YOU HAVEN'T INSTALLED ANOTHER LAUNCHER!
REMOVING CAUSES GESTURES/THREE BUTTON NAVIGATION TO DISAPPEAR ENTIRELY!
https://vikrant.is-a.dev/Android-Launcher-Comparison-Table/ has a comprehensive comparison of many alternative launchers
